content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NID Madhya Pradesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nidmp.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NID Madhya Pradesh Faculty/Designer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Faculty/Designer posts at NID Madhya Pradesh is 30th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Designer/Faculty post?
faq.answer: For the Designer/Faculty position, candidates need a Degree/Diploma in Design from a recognized institution and a minimum of 5 years of experience in the relevant field of Design.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for these recruitment posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Faculty/Designer posts at NID Madhya Pradesh is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), and Ex-Servicemen categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Faculty/Designer positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the Faculty/Designer positions. Specifically, there are 2 vacancies for Designer/Faculty and 5 vacancies for Associate Senior Faculty/Designer (Assistant Professor).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 1000/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates will be as per Pay Level 10 or 11 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, depending on the specific post they are appointed to.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NID Madhya Pradesh recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, Group Discussion, Presentation, Teaching Demonstration, and finally, an Interview. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates, along with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of NID Madhya Pradesh, which is www.nidmp.ac.in. Links are also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
